component.name: powerpoint-voice
component.description: Fully offline voice-controlled PowerPoint presentation controller

tools.name: hand-authored from third_party/PROVENANCE.md and CMakeLists.txt
tools.note: No SBOM generator is installed on the build host (syft/cyclonedx absent). Every hash below is the value recorded in PROVENANCE.md and independently re-verified against the committed file at generation time.

properties.name: network:egress
properties.value: none — the application makes no network calls of any kind; the drag-drop handler explicitly refuses remote URLs so it cannot become the first

properties.name: data:persistence
properties.value: none at run time — TM-011. The speech model is extracted at BUILD time.

components.name: Qt
components.description: Core/Gui/Widgets/Test only, qtbase modules (ADR-0001). Dynamically linked; staged into the .app by macdeployqt for distribution.

components.name: libzip
components.description: Reads the untrusted .pptx package read-only. Decompression caps enforced by the caller before any part is read (TM-014/017).

components.name: pugixml
components.description: Parses OOXML parts. Loader matches by LOCAL name so non-conventional namespace prefixes still parse.

components.name: Vosk
components.description: On-device speech recognition, vendored. 0.3.45 ships no macOS build; 0.3.44 is the last universal2 binary. Header taken from the v0.3.45 tag and ABI-verified with nm -gU.

components.name: vosk-model-small-en-us
components.description: Speech model, vendored via git-LFS and extracted at BUILD time (TM-011 forbids writing a cache at run time). Carries a DYNAMIC graph (graph/HCLr.fst + graph/Gr.fst), which is what makes the grammar constraint bind; a static-graph model would silently decode the full ~200k-word vocabulary.

components.name: miniaudio
components.description: Single-header audio capture. Binds to CoreAudio through the API and resolves AudioUnit/AudioComponent at runtime — never a device index or name.

components.name: doctest
components.description: Test framework. TEST-ONLY — not linked into the shipped application.
